subject.title: Feishu: read image tool result loses media before final outbound payload

question: Which trusted-media promotion shape should own pathless `read` image results for this issue: original tool-args fallback, inbound-media persistence, or a narrower hybrid?
rationale: Both open fixes can plausibly restore media delivery, but the choice changes the local-media trust boundary and cross-channel payload contract, so automation should not select it without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt inbound-media persistence
options.body: Use the https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442-style approach that saves trusted inline image bytes into managed inbound media before reply delivery, then require lint and real behavior proof.

options.title: Repair the start-args fallback
options.body: Port the https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50359 approach to current files and explicitly prove that only trusted `read` paths can become outbound media.

options.title: Split Feishu from shared media
options.body: Keep this issue open for Feishu-specific delivery while moving shared pathless read-image promotion to the WhatsApp/read-image cluster.

recommendation.title: Adopt inbound-media persistence
recommendation.body: Use the https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442-style approach that saves trusted inline image bytes into managed inbound media before reply delivery, then require lint and real behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history on the shared tool-media reply delivery boundary that would own the selected fix shape.
